post_title: J1 visa renewal refused 214(b) PGY1 resident need advice
concerns_or_questions_summary: PGY1 medical resident on a valid ECFMG-sponsored J-1 applied for a J-1 renewal at the Mumbai consulate during vacation and was refused under section 214(b). The user is asking why a physician J-1 renewal would draw a 214(b) refusal, whether the spouse being on H-1B hurt the case, and how to strengthen home-country ties for a successful reapplication.
